CL. 35 Business consulting services in the field of diversity and inclusion strategies for healthcare and biotechnology companies;      business consultation in the field of developing and implementing strategic diversity initiatives for the healthcare sector; business      advisory services relating to inclusive workforce development and employee resource group formation; consulting services in the      field of inclusive marketing and communications strategies for healthcare organizations; business development consulting focused      on inclusion-based innovation in healthcare and biotechnology; human resources consulting related to inclusive hiring, promotion,      and retention practices for healthcare organizations; business management consulting for healthcare executives focused on      implementing inclusive leadership practices; business consulting related to corporate social responsibility programming with an      emphasis on healthcare equity; providing business data analytics services regarding diversity metrics and inclusion key      performance indicators for healthcare organizations; none of the foregoing pertaining to genomics, DNA, RNA, sequencing,      precision medicine, the practice of medicine, medical records, medical diagnostics, medical support, clinical care, clinical decision      support, population health management utilizing genomic or biological data, virology research, epidemiology research, genealogy,      or scientific research in the fields of genomics, genetics, or related biological sciences.

INT. CL. 41 Educational services, namely, conducting workshops, seminars, and training in the field of inclusive research practices for      healthcare and biotechnology; training services in the field of developing inclusive corporate cultures within healthcare      organizations; motivational speaking services related to diversity, inclusion, and innovation in healthcare; arranging and      conducting educational conferences in the field of healthcare inclusion; leadership development training for healthcare executives      with emphasis on inclusive management techniques; educational mentorship programs focused on underrepresented populations      in healthcare and biotechnology; providing non-downloadable webinars in the field of inclusive research methodologies;      educational coaching services for healthcare organizations implementing diversity initiatives; arranging and conducting      educational panel discussions related to inclusive healthcare innovation; educational services in the form of customized corporate      training programs addressing inclusion challenges specific to the healthcare sector; none of the foregoing pertaining to genomics,      DNA, RNA, sequencing, precision medicine, the practice of medicine, medical records, medical diagnostics, medical support,      clinical care, clinical decision support, population health management utilizing genomic or biological data, virology research,      epidemiology research, genealogy, or scientific research in the fields of genomics, genetics, or related biological sciences.

markImageDescriptions.markImageDescription: The mark consists of the stylized word 'QORE' in uppercase letters, with a double-helix DNA strand design positioned within the circular letter 'O'. The DNA strand appears as a twisted ladder structure with horizontal rungs connecting the vertical strands. The letter 'Q' features a distinctive tail that extends below the baseline of the other letters.
